source.title: Composer ™ for Harmony Function Code Application Manual Volume 1 (Function Codes 1 to 174)

name: BCD Input
description: The BCD input block reads a boolean input from an IMDSI12 or IMDSI22 module in a binary coded decimal (BCD) format, and converts it to a real output with quality.
description_lines: The BCD input block reads a boolean input from an IMDSI12
or IMDSI22 module in a binary coded decimal (BCD) format,
and converts it to a real output with quality.

specifications.label: S2
specifications.description: Zone containing ones digit of output: 1 and 2 = zones reside in group B 3 and 4 = zones reside in group A Input number on I/O module:; 1 = 1 to 4 (B) (S4 can be any value); 2 = 5 to 8 (B) (S4 must be =<3); 3 = 1 to 4 (A) (S4 must be =<2); 4 = 5 to 8 (A) (S4 must be set to 1)
description_lines: Zone containing ones digit of output:
1 and 2 = zones reside in group B
3 and 4 = zones reside in group A
